findings.clinical_note: Markedly elevated whole‑blood creatinine indicating severe renal impairment or possible acute kidney injury.
Elevated serum creatinine consistent with chronic kidney disease (stage 2‑3).

findings.test_name: Protein [Mass/volume] in Urine by Test strip
findings.clinical_note: Significant proteinuria (>300 mg/dL) indicating glomerular injury.
Low HbA1c may reflect chronic hypoglycemia, recent carbohydrate restriction, or laboratory error.
Mildly reduced GFR consistent with early chronic kidney disease.

findings.test_name: Urine total bilirubin [Mass/volume] by Test strip
findings.clinical_note: Positive urine bilirubin may indicate hepatic dysfunction or hemolysis.

findings.test_name: Ketones [Mass/volume] in Urine by Test strip
findings.clinical_note: Urine ketonuria suggests increased fat oxidation; consider fasting, low‑carb diet, or uncontrolled diabetes.
